chats.answer:
Are you looking for a 3D printer with a built-in 3D scanner, so you can scan a physical object and then print a copy?

There are two main options:

All-in-one 3D printer + scanner: One machine handles both scanning and printing. These are relatively uncommon.

3D printer + separate 3D scanner: Scan an object, convert it into a 3D model, and print it. This usually offers better flexibility and scanning quality.

For example, you could scan a small plastic replacement part, make adjustments to the model, and print a replacement.
